name: salon-booking-platform
description: Full MERN Stack Salon Booking Platform with User, Vendor, and Admin applications

scripts.dev: concurrently "npm run dev:server" "npm run dev:user" "npm run dev:vendor" "npm run dev:admin"
scripts.install:all: npm install && cd server && npm install && cd ../client/user-app && npm install && cd ../vendor-app && npm install && cd ../admin-panel && npm install
scripts.build:all: npm run build:user && npm run build:vendor && npm run build:admin
